caption: The drawing depicts a bust of a woman set against a plain, light beige background. The bust shows the woman from the lower chest upward, adorned in formal attire. Her hair is styled in an elaborate updo with sections colored in black and gold, and she wears dangling gold earrings. She has a pale complexion and neutral facial expression, with her eyes looking slightly to the side. The woman is dressed in an off-the-shoulder, dark brown garment that is decorated with a red necklace and gold framed pendant at the center. Around her shoulders is a blue scarf or ribbon that is tied in a bow at the front. The lower part of the bust includes gold quilt-like material that supports the structure. In the lower right corner, there is small writing indicating details about the bust. The composition is centered, and there is no background detail aside from the plain color.
title: Figurehead for Ship "Marcia Allen"
